items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: Snoozer Quinn, one of the real greats, all-time greats.

ctx.x: I'm sure that he gave them about a 15, 20 minute spot. Oh, boy. Which was a great, which was a great spot. And then that, after that, that's when we went out to Paul Merez's home. And that's when we really got something real going there, you know, with Bix playing the trumpet, you know. And had Izzy Friedman playing clarinet. Snoozer Quinn, one of the real greats, all-time greats. And, well, I said Eddie Miller and, well, they had, that was the local boys, you know. And I can't think, they had some of the other…
